title: Rejection of an Invalid Tail
statement: Let $f$ map finite bit strings to finite bit strings, and suppose there are natural numbers $C,e$ such that $|f(x)|\le C(|x|+1)^e$ for every bit string $x$. For either Boolean value $\mathrm{mode}$ and any bit strings $z$ and $\mathrm{tail}$, if it is not the case that $\mathrm{tail}$ is canonical and its length is at most the length of the binary representation of $(2C+3)(|\langle z,\mathrm{tail}\rangle|+1)^{e+1}$, then the indicator of the specified language is false on $\langle z,\mathrm{tail}\rangle$.
hypotheses_covered: failure of the conjunction that $\mathrm{tail}$ is canonical and meets the stated length bound
